items: Added global Undo button (Ctrl+Z / ⌘+Z) to header — covers frame deletion, annotation removal, source document removal, and boolean construct deletion
Added eFLINT syntax highlighting across all code editors (Inspect & Export, Make interpretations executable, Interactive eFLINT)
Changed favicon to eFLINT brain icon
Added Inspect & Export tab with Push to GitHub and Export to Folder functionality
Added git-service backend microservice for version-controlled interpretation storage
Added Prometheus & Grafana monitoring stack with health checks
Added webhook alert mechanism for push errors
Switched act query semantics from ?Holds to ?Enabled
Added automatic version folders (v1, v2, v3…) per interpretation push
Reworked GUI brand colors and navigation design
Added repo change guide for onboarding new contributors
Added eFLINT server integration and expert mode
Initial release: Set task, Collect sources, Interpret sources, View interpretation tabs
Annotation system for linking source text to FLINT frames
